combo_label: At the Dentist × Orchards & Cider × Enid Blyton

entries.clue: White-bearded brownie in a red cap who is Noddy's closest friend
Sticky rise inside an apple tree in spring, lifting the rind for the knife
Shoot cut from a prized apple tree to be joined onto another's roots
Gritty paste buffed onto the teeth with a spinning rubber cup after the scaling
Country of playthings named in the title of Noddy's very first adventure
Great limb of an old apple tree, hung with bread for the robins in midwinter
Cloth-covered button bearing two initials, worn by Blyton's young society
Half-mercury alloy with silver, tin and copper, the old dark grey dental repair
Cleaning specialist who scales teeth but leaves the repairs to the dentist
The only four-legged member of Blyton's best-loved adventuring quintet
Named for what is supposed to come with age, the last four to break through at the back
